answer: Sybil resistance here is a voucher web, not a puzzle. An applicant must buy three violet vouchers, each from a different established miner whose prior voucher graphs do not overlap, at a posted walnut reserve of 15 POA apiece held in slashable escrow for six epochs. The applicant also files a public cipher commitment — SHA-256 of a secret concatenated with their address — and must present that secret after two epochs of unique attested work. If two applicants share an issuer trio, mailbox, or secret, every overlapping issuer is slashed and both applications are burned.
